reverse.title: Reverse the wage journal of {date}?
reverse.body: TILL books a correcting entry that takes this wage journal back. The original entry stays visible. Salary payments, AHV, BVG and withholding tax declarations and wage statements happen outside TILL and stay as they are: correct them in your payroll system, then upload the corrected wage journal.

Hr.title: HR
Hr.body: HR bundles three loops: employees, absences and expenses. Personal data is specially protected: the AHV number renders masked, and without HR rights you see only your own entries. An expense can never be approved by the person who submitted it. Payroll itself happens outside TILL; this surface prepares the handoff for it.
